story_type: swimmer lowered beside a tanker's mast far offshore
hook: A rescue swimmer on a cable, right beside a tanker's mast.
narration: This rescue swimmer is dangling on a cable, right beside a tanker's mast.
Two hundred twenty-three miles southeast of Cape Hatteras, an injured crewman aboard the tanker needed a hospital.
A Jayhawk crew from Coast Guard Air Station Elizabeth City flew out to get him.
A ship's masts and rigging can snag a hoist cable, so the pilot has to hold a steady hover while the swimmer is lowered to the deck. [short pause]
outcome: The Jayhawk crew hoisted the forty-one-year-old man and flew him to Sentara Norfolk General Hospital.

title: Swimmer lowered beside a tanker mast
description:
A Coast Guard Air Station Elizabeth City MH-60 Jayhawk crew lowered a rescue swimmer to a tanker about 223 miles southeast of Cape Hatteras, North Carolina, on July 19, 2021, and flew an injured 41-year-old crewman to Sentara Norfolk General Hospital.
